title: A School Trip
description: Practise past tenses and prepositions, then write a postcard about a school trip.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your postcard in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🚌 Last Friday our class ___ on a trip to the zoo.
exercises.explanation: "Go" is irregular. The past simple is "went".

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: We ___ (meet) at school at eight o'clock.
exercises.explanation: "Meet" is irregular. The past simple is "met".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We travelled by bus for an hour.
exercises.explanation: Subject + past verb + by + transport: We travelled by bus for an hour.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: It ___ when we arrived at the zoo.
exercises.explanation: We use the past continuous for a longer action in the past: it was raining.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Our teacher buyed tickets for everyone.
answers: Our teacher bought tickets for everyone.
exercises.explanation: "Buy" is irregular. The past simple is "bought".

exercises.prompt: Write a word: under, behind, next to or near.
exercises.text: 🦒 The giraffes were ___ the big trees.
exercises.explanation: Prepositions tell us where things are.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: The guide ___ showed us the zoo was very friendly.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" for people.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Did you see the baby elephant.
exercises.explanation: "Did" + subject + base verb: Did you see the baby elephant?

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: The elephant was ___ than the zebra.
exercises.explanation: Use the comparative "bigger" with "than".

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word NOISIER. Begin: "The ..."
exercises.text: The lions were not as noisy as the monkeys.
answers: The monkeys were noisier than the lions.
exercises.explanation: "A is not as noisy as B" means "B is noisier than A".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: We didn't ___ (have) lunch until twelve o'clock.
exercises.explanation: After "didn't" use the base verb: didn't have.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We arrived back at school on four o'clock.
answers: We arrived back at school at four o'clock.
exercises.explanation: Use "at" with clock times.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I was tired ___ I was very happy.
exercises.explanation: "But" joins two different ideas.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I have never seen a real tiger before.
exercises.explanation: Subject + have + never + past participle: I have never seen a real tiger before.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Linh ___ lots of photos of the animals.
exercises.explanation: "Take" is irregular. The past simple is "took".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the adjective in brackets.
exercises.text: 🐧 The penguins were the ___ (funny) animals of all.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives ending in -y change to -iest.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word SPENT. Begin: "We ..."
exercises.text: We stayed at the zoo for six hours, from ten to four.
answers: We spent six hours at the zoo.
exercises.explanation: "Spend time" is irregular: spent.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: You shoulds take a hat when it is sunny.
answers: You should take a hat when it is sunny.
exercises.explanation: "Should" never changes: you should.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: If you ___ a map, you will not get lost.
exercises.explanation: After "if" we use the present simple.

exercises.prompt: Write one word.
exercises.text: 🐄 Next month we are ___ to visit a farm.
exercises.explanation: Use "going to" for plans.

task.prompt: You are on a school trip to a museum. Write a postcard to your friend.
contentPoints: Say where you are and who you are with.
Say what you did this morning.
Say what the best thing was.
Say what you are going to do next.
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Ben,

Today we are at the science museum with our class. This morning we saw a big dinosaur and we learned about space. The best thing was the robot show. It was very funny! Later we are going to have lunch in the park. I wish you were here.

Best wishes,
Nam
